summary: Helus Pharma Inc. (formerly Cybin Inc.), a Canadian clinical-stage pharmaceutical issuer, filed a Form 6-K carrying a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report disclosing that co-founders Eric So (President and Executive Chairman, formerly Interim CEO) and Paul Glavine (Chief Growth Officer, formerly COO and CEO) stepped down from executive and consulting roles effective October 26, 2026, while retaining board seats. The Board appointed director Mark Lawson, a private equity and investment banking executive, as independent Chair, and named So Chairman Emeritus. No financial terms, advisor, or recommendation were disclosed. Watch board reconstitution and any further executive departures.
